later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater classification: Tockler performs packaged-build update checks through electron-updater and restricts auto-update support to selected packaged targets; release verification is delegated to electron-updater/OS signing.

Where electron-updater/Squirrel/install4j performs final verification, the external framework implementation is not vendored here.
